rules.statement: A contract for the transfer of a portion of land out of a lot allotted in a partition decree can be enforced even if the extent of the land is less than agreed upon, provided that the subject-matter is sufficiently identified.
rules.supporting_quote: 'In regard to (a) it is a proposition of law that Courts before enforcing a contract must be satisfied that it is certain. Uncertainty may arise in various ways... In my opinion the subject-matter of the contract was sufficiently Identified and this contention fails.'
